# laravelforge_server_event (Data Source)

Fetches a single Laravel Forge server provisioning/operation event by ID on a server.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) ID of the event.
- `organization` (String) Organization slug.
- `server_id` (Number) Numeric ID of the server that the event belongs to.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `description` (String) Description of the event.
- `ran_as` (String) Server user that the event was run as.
- `updated_at` (String) Last-updated timestamp.
